title: Categorical isomorphism for sections of a punctured power-series thickening
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sbc-power-series-punctured-thickening-restriction, the canonical morphism from the quotient affine scheme to sections on the punctured thickening is an isomorphism in CommRingCat.

source.place: Tag 0EY9, first displayed calculation at a fixed index.

proof.text: The quotient spectrum is Noetherian by MvPowerSeries.isNoetherianRing and quotient Noetherianity. Apply the new boundary-depth theorem to get depth at least two at every point outside W=q inverse-image V.

Apply the depth-two Hartogs module theorem to the structure module of the quotient spectrum. It is quasi-coherent and finite on affine opens because its sections are the section ring itself. The private helpers identify its abelian-group-valued stalk linearly with the ring-valued structure stalk, using preservation of the filtered colimit by forgetting rings to abelian groups. Transport depth through this linear equivalence. Module restriction-unit components and ring restriction components are identical as functions, so ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective proves W.ι.c invertible; its top component W.ι.appTop is invertible.

The composite of pullbackSymmetry and pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict identifies the pullback in the conclusion with W. Its inverse followed by pullback.snd is W.ι. Contravariant comp_appTop identifies W.ι.appTop with pullback.snd.appTop followed by the inverse isomorphism on sections. Cancel the latter with isIso_comp_right_iff, then compose with ΓSpecIso.inv. The resulting morphism is exactly the canonical map in the unchanged conclusion.

theorem isIso_powerSeries_punctured_thickening_restriction
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso
      ((ΓSpecIso (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A ⧸ FiniteEtale.Adic.ideal
        (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) n))).inv ≫
        (pullback.snd V.ι (FiniteEtale.Adic.baseMap
          (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) n)).appTop)
